message: text:我會依照 execute 技能檢查本地指引與 inbox 輸入，透過現有 owner 讀取目前狀態，再保存供下一位 reviewer 接手的 handoff。

$ python3 -B -c 'import os; from pathlib import Path; p=Path(os.environ[\"NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR\"]).parent/\"inbox\"; files=[\"identity-input.json\",\"runtime-readback.json\",\"checkpoint.json\",\"provider.json\",\"historical-seed.json\"]; [(print(\"FILE: \"+f),print((p/f).read_text())) for f in files]'

$ python3 -B ./soodles.py landing advance --help; python3 -B ./soodles.py landing resume --help; python3 -B ./soodles.py landing identity --help; git show --stat --oneline HEAD; git diff HEAD''^ HEAD -- AGENTS.md .agents/skills/execute/SKILL.md; rg -n '"'landing|def main' soodles.py

$ python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os,json,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent/'inbox'
for f in ['checkpoint.json','provider.json']:
 print('BEFORE',f,hashlib.sha256((p/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
for args in [['identity'],['advance',str(p/'checkpoint.json'),str(p/'provider.json')]]:
 command=['python3','-B','./soodles.py','landing',*args]
 result=subprocess.run(command,text=True,capture_output=True)
 print(json.dumps({'command':command,'exit_code':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr}))
for f in ['checkpoint.json','provider.json']:
 print('AFTER',f,hashlib.sha256((p/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('STAGE_IDENTITY',json.dumps({k:os.environ[k] for k in ['NOODLE_SESSION_ID','NOODLE_ORDER_ID','NOODLE_STAGE_INDEX']}))

text:目前 owner 回傳 `readback / merge_pending`：merge 已被 offered，但尚無結果確認，不能重送歷史 merge request。checkpoint 與 provider 檔案在檢查前後未變；我會在 handoff 明列此狀態，並要求後續使用新的模擬 readback 繼續檢查。

$ python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os,json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
p=Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent/'inbox'
def read(name): return json.loads((p/name).read_text())
def digest(name): return hashlib.sha256((p/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
task=read('task-input.json'); cp=read('checkpoint.json'); provider=read('provider.json'); runtime=read('runtime-readback.json')
expected={'checkpoint.json':'cfb0fdaf7f9e844a85032c447aa627b2fa01b879681987241f25f3b5d2c69c44','provider.json':'6b403104a5db060b295b0b325643d142136f73b8dcc90cd20b48b39f7395c57b'}
assert all(digest(k)==v for k,v in expected.items()), 'Fixture changed since owner observation; refresh needed'
command=['python3','-B','./soodles.py','landing','advance',str(p/'checkpoint.json'),str(p/'provider.json')]
record={
 'schema':1,
 'created_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'scope':'已獲准的獨立唯讀 fixture review；本 handoff 為 producer 觀察，不是後續 consumer 執行證據，也不授權 landing。',
 'source':{
  'repository':task['repository'], 'actual_head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
  'assigned_instruction_ref':task['assigned_instruction_ref'], 'common_code_ref':task['common_code_ref'],
  'worktree':str(Path.cwd()), 'owner_entry':task['owner_entry'],
  'code_observation':'HEAD 相對 common_code_ref 僅六個指引／文件檔案有差異；owner 程式未變。工作樹乾淨，git diff --check 通過。',
  'owner_identity_observed':read('identity-input.json'),
  'identity_validation':'實際執行 landing identity，exit 0；輸出 verifier_sha256 與 identity-input.json 及 checkpoint claim 相同。此比對不新增外部授權。',
  'carrier':'現有 Noodle 管理的 isolated-worktree child；沿用 supplied local owner，無新增 session／worktree。',
  'session_id':os.environ['NOODLE_SESSION_ID'], 'order_id':os.environ['NOODLE_ORDER_ID'], 'stage_index':int(os.environ['NOODLE_STAGE_INDEX'])},
 'input_identity':{name:{'path':str(p/name),'sha256':digest(name)} for name in ['task-input.json','identity-input.json','checkpoint.json','provider.json','historical-seed.json','runtime-readback.json']},
 'checkpoint':{'claim':cp['claim'],'schema':cp['schema'],'phase':cp['phase'],'delivery':cp['delivery'],'writes_offered':cp['writes_offered'],'observations':cp['observations'],'unchanged_after_owner':True},
 'current_owner_observation':{
  'command':command,'exit_code':0,'stderr':'',
  'output_projection':{'owner':'landing.advance','action':'readback','phase':'merge_pending','classification':None,'next':{'kind':'provider_readback','owner':'GitHub','operation':'advance','required':['readback'],'known':{'checkpoint':str(p/'checkpoint.json')}}},
  'projection_note':'摘錄本次真實 owner 輸出；不是完整平台 transcript。next 另列 PR、Issue、commit、branch、run、jobs 的 GET readback，與 merged 時的 merge_commit 讀取；這些 fixture URL 均不可傳送 GitHub。',
  'new_write_request_emitted':False,
  'provider_observation':{'pr':provider['pr']['number'],'pr_state':provider['pr']['state'],'pr_merged':provider['pr']['merged'],'issue':provider['issue']['number'],'issue_state':provider['issue']['state'],'run_id':provider['run']['id'],'run_attempt':provider['run']['run_attempt']},
  'conclusion':'merge 已 offered 且結果未確認；目前只能等待新的 fixture provider readback。PR 未合併、Issue 開啟的現有快照不授權重送。'},
 'historical_material':{'path':str(p/'historical-seed.json'),'status':'歷史合成輸入，非 current owner output','historical_request':read('historical-seed.json')['historical_request'],'instruction':'不得重播、dispatch 或送往 GitHub；不能把歷史 transport note 當成目前下一步。'},
 'common_runtime_evidence':{
  'source':'supplied runtime-readback.json，未重新查詢 provider',
  'run_id':runtime['run']['id'],'run_attempt':runtime['run']['run_attempt'],'head_sha':runtime['run']['head_sha'],'status':runtime['run']['status'],'conclusion':runtime['run']['conclusion'],
  'job_id':runtime['jobs']['jobs'][0]['id'],
  'scope_limit':'真實 common-code runtime run/job/acceptance step 顯示 success；未讀取 artifact bytes。不能證明 fixture merge／closure／reconciliation，也不能證明此 review HEAD 或 Issue 39 已交付。'},
 'supported_continuation':{
  'required_input':'由既有 supervisor／fixture owner 提供針對同一 claim、可釐清 offered merge 結果的新模擬 provider readback。',
  'consumer_steps':['重新讀取實際 checkpoint/provider，驗證 source 與 claim 身分，勿將 handoff 快照當成最新狀態。','依 python3 -B ./soodles.py landing advance --help，以既有 checkpoint 及新的模擬 readback 執行 owner；消費當次 next。','若仍要求 readback，保留 pending，不重送歷史 merge、不變更 admission、不重複無新資料的嘗試。'],
  'live_provider_requests_allowed':False,
  'consumer_has_run':False},
 'stage_handoff':{'outcome':'blocked','blocking':True,'reason':'本次 fixture review 與 handoff 已完成；offered merge 缺少結果 readback，且本實驗不交付 production Issue。','issue_resolved':False},
 'authorizes_landing':False
}
output=p/'handoff.json'
with output.open('x') as f: f.write(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\\n')
loaded=json.loads(output.read_text())
assert loaded['checkpoint']['claim']==cp['claim'] and loaded['supported_continuation']['consumer_has_run'] is False
print(json.dumps({'handoff':str(output),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'validated':True},ensure_ascii=False))

command=['/Users/neon/.codex/experiments/noodle84-20260917/noodle-merged-ca81','event','emit','stage_message','--session',os.environ['NOODLE_SESSION_ID'],'--payload',json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False)]
